dataset: SPHEREx Quick Release 3 spectral image MEF

cutout.method: Astropy Cutout2D from the verified original product

notes: The official IRSA cutout service returned HTTP 503 during acquisition; the complete product was read from the official public S3 mirror.
The sample keeps image, detector flags, variance, zodiacal model and the wavelength WCS table; it omits the ePSF table because the demonstrator does not perform PSF fitting.
Only the celestial cutout WCS is reconstructed; the retained original WCS-WAVE table is reference context and is not a validated cutout spectral WCS.
All extracted peak centers in this sample carry the upstream SOURCE mask bit; these outputs are not independent source-discovery evidence.
SPHEREx data acknowledgment and current QR release guidance are in the IRSA mission and archive documentation.
